cause_claim: The proposed change adds GRANT SELECT ON r0.* TO svc_bundle_reader. This gives the bundle-builder reader access to the r0 shard database in addition to the default database. In the candidate run, the bundle-builder read 280 rows total (140 from default + 140 from r0), producing a bundle with 280 entries (8731 bytes). The worker-runtime has a preallocation limit that causes it to refuse to start when the bundle exceeds the limit; the experiment output stated "fatal: bundle has 280 entries but the runtime preallocates 200; refusing to start". Baseline run with only the default grant produced 140 entries and exit code 0.
